about: Round 56: goals a person might give the agent, each labelled with the tool(s) a correct run needs (the first one is what the model must reach for). Written by hand, in English and Thai, before the menu ranker existed; 'dev' is the set the ranker was built against and may be re-measured, 'holdout' was written at the same time and measured once after the ranker was fixed. A goal can need more than one tool; the ranker is credited only when ALL the needed tools stay on the menu.
